description: Check that evidence covers the scope of the claim it is used for (geography, population, period, version, basis, unit) — Compares the scope descriptors of a claim and of the evidence offered for it, per dimension: geography and population (every claimed item must be equal to, or contained in a broader evidence item according to the caller's taxonomy), period (the evidence period must contain the claimed period; partial or no overlap is a mismatch), and version, basis and unit (must be equal after normalization). Des

claim.description: Scope of the claim being made.

basis.description: Measurement basis: per capita, nominal, mean, gross, as-reported...

population.description: Who/what is covered (adults, EU residents, Series A startups).

taxonomy.description: Containment facts for geography and population (40,000 characters in total), e.g. {broader:'United States', narrower:['California','Texas']}. Transitive.
